description: Transit Operators that filed late or failed to file FY - FTRs is a series of datasets listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Controller's Office. Transit Operators that filed late or failed to file their Financial Transactions Report with the State Controller's Office for fiscal year 2019-20. Coverage: California. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher California State Controller's Office. Its tags are california state controllers office, transit, transit operators, who filed late or failed to file. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XSL. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
